fields.description: Direction lives here, never in the sign of the amount. A correction is a Reversal entry pointing at the original event — never a cancellation and never an edit, so the trail stays complete.
fields.label: Kind
fields.options:
Receipt
Expenditure
Receipt Reversal
Expenditure Reversal

fields.description: Must be greater than zero. Only submitted events count towards any figure; a draft counts for nothing.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: Required for a Reversal: the submitted event of the matching kind, on the same project, that this entry reverses. A reversal cannot exceed what remains unreversed of it.
fields.label: Reverses

fields.description: A cross-stage comparison (spent over received, received over sanctioned) is an overridable warning, not a constraint — it genuinely happens. Submitting is refused once with the figures named; confirming requires all three fields below.
fields.label: Override Confirmed

fields.description: Must equal, character for character, the warning string the refusal issued. Change the amount and the string changes, so a stale confirmation is refused.
fields.label: Override Acknowledges
